title: Circular/Crossing reference of PackedScenes makes referred scenes unable to load
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.beta5

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta5.mono - Arch Linux #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:04:24 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7650 GRE - AMD Ryzen 5 7500F 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 30.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

A node can reference another scene through the script's PackedScene class export property. If such a node is in a scene that forms a circular/cross-reference relationship with the scene it references, then the editor will refuse to open any of the referred scenes. Affected scenes can only be manually edited with a text editor to fix the problem.

I was trying to utilize export properties to rid resource paths off from my scripts(used in scene switching), then a circular reference accidentally emerged and crashed nearly all of my project. The issue is also documented in #107639. I expect that the engine could handle the reference properly, or at least pop an alert before a circular reference forms.

### Steps to reproduce

Load the MRP and try to open any one of the 3 scenes. The following errors are outputted:
```
  ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:279 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://scene_3.tscn:8]
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://scene_3.tscn.
  ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:279 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://scene_2.tscn:8]
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://scene_2.tscn.
  ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:279 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://scene_1.tscn:8]
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://scene_1.tscn.
```

Attempt to run the project (scene_1 is the main scene) results in error:
```
E 0:00:00:264   _printerr: res://scene_3.tscn:8 - Parse Error: [ext_resource] referenced non-existent resource at: res://scene_1.tscn.
  <C++ Source>  scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:40 @ _printerr()
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[circular_reference_test_2025-08-19_19-32-38.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21854722/circular_reference_test_2025-08-19_19-32-38.zip)
